name: DIY homunculus

VINIT.justification: void before any genome or apparatus exists

TANCH.justification: final containment of the completed homunculus

CLINK.justification: sequential composition of genome edits to oscillator output

IMSCRIB.justification: cell reads its own methylation state

FSPLIT.justification: one clonal population branches into three specialized subtypes

EVALT.justification: affirmative verification that >90% cells express all markers

ENGAGR.justification: paradice held without resolution of chirality conflict

IFIX.justification: permanent append-only record of verified state

phase_2.fuse_result: unified homunculus expressing all three lineage markers simultaneously

phase_3.void_description: undifferentiated synthetic genome before any CRISPR or oscillator modules
phase_3.true_description: C ≥ 0.828 with both gates open and verified mutual information
phase_3.false_description: lineage markers expressed sequentially or triple-positive fraction < 50%
phase_3.both_description: L- and D-proteomes active simultaneously inside the same cell

steps.domain_action: prepare fresh medium and sterilize microfluidic array
aliquot clonal culture into three separate chambers
add IPTG to drive oscillator past bifurcation
program valve sequence linking Scribe edits to Gate output
read fluorescence to confirm cell recognizes its own state
supplement D-amino acids allowing simultaneous L/D translation
reverse valve flow so Gate modulates Scribe epigenome
open all valves simultaneously for quorum-sensing broadcast
if damping detected, adjust AHL concentrations and restart from AFWD
cryopreserve verified aliquot as immutable record
recompose full loop from oscillator induction onward

phase_6.cycle_cost: reagents, AHL molecules, and metabolic energy per cycle
phase_6.post_cycle_state: differentiated homunculus at C=0.828 with closed causal loop
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — self-referential Frobenius closure conserves structural information
